summary: WatchNexus v1.2.5 Feature Testing Complete - All requested features verified: SVG favicon displays correctly, IndexerHealthCheck component with Setup Guide button works, skip-segments and next-episode API endpoints respond properly, VideoPlayer has skip/next episode button structure
critical_code_review_comments: IndexerHealthCheck component correctly shows status and Setup Guide when no indexers enabled
VideoPlayer skip-segment and next-episode buttons use proper data-testid attributes
skip-segments endpoint returns 404/503 for non-existent media (expected - Marmalade server not running)
next-episode endpoint returns 404/503 for non-existent media (expected - Marmalade server not running)
context_for_next_testing_agent: v1.2.5 features verified. SVG favicon at /watchnexus-logo.svg. IndexerHealthCheck component in Settings > Indexers shows status overview with Setup Guide button (modal with 3 steps). VideoPlayer.jsx has skip-segment button (data-testid='skip-segment-btn') and next-episode prompt (data-testid='play-next-btn') - these only appear during actual video playback when segments are detected or near end of episode.

svg_favicon.description: SVG favicon displays in browser tab
svg_favicon.details: link rel='icon' type='image/svg+xml' href='/watchnexus-logo.svg' present in index.html

indexer_health_check.description: IndexerHealthCheck component visible in Settings > Indexers
components_verified: Indexer Status section with status indicator
No indexers enabled message (when none configured)
Setup Guide modal with 3 steps (Enable Indexer, Test Connection, Search Media)

setup_guide_button.description: Setup Guide button visible when no indexers enabled
setup_guide_button.details: Opens modal with step-by-step guidance for configuring indexers

settings_sidebar_navigation.description: Settings page has sidebar with Indexers under MEDIA ACQUISITION

video_player_skip_button.description: VideoPlayer has skip intro/credits button structure
video_player_skip_button.details: Button with data-testid='skip-segment-btn' renders when currentSkipSegment is active

video_player_next_episode.description: VideoPlayer has next episode prompt with auto-play
video_player_next_episode.details: Shows countdown timer, Play Now button (data-testid='play-next-btn'), and cancel option

api_skip_segments.response: Returns 404 when media not found (expected), 200 with segments when media exists

api_next_episode.response: Returns 404 when media not found (expected), 200 with next episode info when available

mocked_apis.note: skip-segments and next-episode endpoints return real responses but require Marmalade server with actual media files to return segment data
